content.text:
Here is the complete picture:

---

**1. Loader — `ModelLoader` (GLTFLoader + DRACOLoader)**

`c:\Users\edn_y\renew_nineonelabs\resource\ts\core\ModelLoader.ts`

- Line 3: `GLTFLoader` imported from `three/addons`
- Line 4: `DRACOLoader` imported from `three/addons`
- Lines 38–49: `_setupDRACO()` sets decoder path to `https://www.gstatic.com/draco/versioned/decoders/1.5.7/` and attaches it to the `GLTFLoader`
- Line 87: `this._gltf.load(url, ...)` — no `THREE.Cache` is used or set

**2. File path used**

`c:\Users\edn_y\renew_nineonelabs\resource\ts\config\object.config.ts`, line 405:

```
modelUrl: "/resource/models/rocket_draco.glb?v=2",
```

The `?v=2` cache-bust suffix means the deleted `rocket_draco.glb` (git status shows `D resource/models/rocket_draco.glb`) is still the configured target. The new `rocket.glb` file in git is not referenced by any TS config or loader call — the config still points to the old draco filename.

Path resolution happens in `c:\Users\edn_y\renew_nineonelabs\resource\ts\core\SceneObject.ts` lines 82–88: prepends `data-base` attribute from `document.documentElement`, then normalises slashes.

**3. Caching layer**

`ModelLoader` has its own internal `_modelMap: Map<string, THREE.Group>` (line 27). On cache hit (line 74–83) it clones the cached group and clones materials in-place — no `THREE.Cache` is involved. The cache key is the full URL string (including `?v=2`).

**4. Scene/page**

Rocket is active in the **main page** only.

- `c:\Users\edn_y\renew_nineonelabs\resource\ts\pages\main\scene\main.scene.ts` line 991: `[rocket]: true` — rocket object is enabled in the main scene config
- `c:\Users\edn_y\renew_nineonelabs\resource\ts\app\ObjectSetup.ts` lines 1, 69: `Rocket` is instantiated via `createSetOptionsSpec` and registered under the `rocket` object ID
- `c:\Users\edn_y\renew_nineonelabs\resource\ts\objects\rocket\Rocket.ts` line 112: `ctx.loadModel(this.resolveAssetPath(modelUrl))` is the call site that feeds into `ModelLoader.loadGLTF`

**Potential issue flagged:** `resource/models/rocket_draco.glb` is deleted in the working tree but `object.config.ts:405` still references `/resource/models/rocket_draco.glb?v=2`. The replacement `rocket.glb` exists on disk but is not wired into the config. The rocket will fail to load until `object.config.ts` is updated to point to the new filename.
